artifact_inventory.description: Standalone numerical check of the exact common-delay threshold, first-mode ordering, and characteristic residual for K_p=2, K_n=1, N=20.

limitations: Restricted to K_p>K_n>0 for the stability conclusions. The no-open-bounded-phase statement is a robust transverse spectral result and does not cover specially prepared histories. The equal-delay theorem gives the exact first stability loss; the general two-delay parametrization does not by itself label every stability cell. Nonlinear, switching-graph, noisy, and time-varying-delay systems are outside scope.
provenance: Scientific derivation from the Fourier-mode characteristic equation of the cited delayed signed-ring consensus model, using exact phase parametrization, scalar one-delay factorization, and standard retarded-delay spectral theory.
record_title: Exact switching geometry and no robust bounded phase in a delayed signed consensus ring
